text:
morgan: deploy-bot held rc-2026-03-21: artifacts-restore hung on cache lock, blocking promotion.
deploy-bot: Promotion held: release=rc-2026-03-21, job=artifacts-restore, reason=cache lock contention + restore timeout (attempts=3).
lee: logs show LRU eviction GC ran during restore, left stale index entries. We should avoid full GC during release windows.
aks: can we do a targeted index repair + rerun the job? I'm wary of reuploading unless necessary.
morgan: agree. plan: repair index -> rerun artifacts-restore (single attempt) -> if green promote to dedicated, keep prod held until change window. If rerun fails, pin to last-known-good and open rollback PR.
deploy-bot: Rerun requested by @aks: job=artifacts-restore (attempt 4) queued.
oncall-bot: FYI change window 2026-03-22 15:00-17:00 UTC. Emergency rollbacks outside window require oncall approval.
lee: running index-repair command: `./infra/cachectl repair --prefix=ci/artifacts/rc-2026-03-21 --dry-run` then commit if good.
aks: dry-run shows 3 tombstones and 1 missing manifest pointer. I'll repair only the tombstones and mark the pointer for reupload.
morgan: sounds good. keep promo held for prod regardless. deploy-bot, do not auto-approve.
deploy-bot: Promotion will remain held until manual `deploy-bot approve-promo`.
lee: repair done, rerun triggered. artifacts fetched successfully on attempt 4. integration tests starting.
aks: tests passing so far. if full canary passes, we promote to dedicated and add release note: "Held for prod; artifacts index repair performed; no rollback required."
morgan: I'll draft the release notes and schedule the manual prod flip during the change window. close loop once promoted to dedicated.
lee: leaving a follow-up ticket to add pre-GC lock pause during release windows and a cachectl check as part of pipeline.
aks: thanks all. no rollback needed.
